scope: Archived measurements on Pupper and offline tests of the new headless path. No new Pi, Hailo, motor or physical pink-ball run.

course.accelerator: 8L HEF run on Hailo8 in field log. Published SDK benchmark rates for newer HEFs/hosts do not measure this configuration.

gui.observation: Viser started, advertised legacy /detections, one viewer connected and disconnected; Hailo8L-on-Hailo8 warning.

historical_field.thermal_method: Nearest firmware sample within 5.1 seconds of ROS bag log time, by UTC on that same Pi. Counted true live-throttle bit 2 separately from historical bits. This sparse association cannot measure sub-sample throttling, camera/Hailo temperature, or causality.
historical_field.late_source_method: Subtracted original integer captured_at_ros_ns from MCAP log_time for each /fc/obstacle_detections message. This includes scheduling and bag/middleware delay. Individual JPEG or Hailo timings were not recorded.
historical_field.guard_window: 57.196 s from first to last monotonic at in attack-final-west.jsonl; 276 status samples, 168 ready, 46 stale, 62 rebuilding the three-frame clear streak (32 on first, 30 on second). Zero nonzero guard outputs or kick receipts. See field-offense-final-20261120.json.
historical_field.camera_ground_truth: No raw or compressed camera images in this bag. Zero frames contained sports-ball class 32; visibility and field recall unknown.
historical_field.other_physical_evidence: In live-camera-perception-reviewed.json, an earlier six-frame camera-only test saw two people in all six with mean SDK call time 23.72 ms (22.41–26.22). It used different conditions, produced other tensors and included deliberate pauses. It was not a sustained FPS or full-field latency test.

replay.source: front-camera-20261117-a/telemetry/telemetry_0.mcap; actual 1400x1050 JPEGs from seconds 64–113 of the archived demonstration timeline
replay.source_poses: People approaching and crossing, plus a narrow tower. This window was used in tracker development.

optical_fixture.method: 49x49 annotated overhead optical patch including a small displayed line. Resize to a circular patch of radius 6, 12, 24 or 42 pixels and insert on a moving trajectory after onboard lens projection. Exposure, optical blur and physical occlusion were not reproduced.

replay.comparison: No model outputs were supplied in negative or colour-only runs. Confirmed-mode input had an injected correct semantic box in every positive frame, measuring fusion wiring only.
replay.miss_definition: Correct requires a tracked center within the inserted radius. Searching and ambiguous have zero published position.
replay.timing: Warm wall time on host, excluding network, ROS, Hailo, hardware capture and first map allocation. Median/p95/max computed across 489 frames. Same pixels compares previous RGB-before-remap and new RGB-after-remap, all channels.
replay.independent_nonpink: Eight previously archived onboard equirectangular photos of the red/white/blue beach ball across two poses from the 2026-11-16 stock-shot ball-frames produced zero confirmed tracks; sparse source stamps exceed the two-frame acquisition window. Five frames contained an initial colour-only candidate.

software_checks.ros: Network-isolated ARM64 ros:jazzy-ros-base, real camera_ros-compatible best-effort compressed image publication, actual ROS subscription and headless CLI, fixed lens map, OpenCV 4.10.0.84, mock Hailo infer() supplying person and sports ball, synthetic JPEG input. No camera_ros driver, sensor, device, controllers or Pi.
ros_results: pink and confirmed both reported pink+yolo on the pink object
confirmed reported searching on a black image despite unchanged semantic boxes
off confirmed while both person and ball remained in the obstacle payload
every matched pair carried identical source capture and sequence
SIGINT closed ROS cleanly with a zero process exit

new_behavior.inputs: one compressed-camera subscription and one pinned Hailo inference per selected frame
new_behavior.output: /fc/onboard_ball (display only), before expiry; guarded /fc/obstacle_detections first and unchanged
new_behavior.mode_inputs: per-robot ticketed SSH runner command onboard_ball_mode -> /fc/onboard_ball_mode; actual mode comes from measured detector telemetry
new_behavior.bearing: Nominal camera-right longitude from endpoint rays of the fixed 220-degree projection with actual image width. Camera-body yaw and physical uncertainty unmeasured.
new_behavior.instrumentation: Full recording logs receipt, decode, warp, Hailo SDK duration, host inference completion, obstacle publish, optional ball completion and overwrite count to detector-timings.jsonl.

next_measurement: Pi-only camera qualification under field lights with actual ball, distractors and occlusion through a cold-to-warm run. Sample physics-free ROS stamps, timings, temperature and firmware flags together. Image evidence can qualify detection independent from motion.
